prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic bright airy villa lifestyle portrait with a textured white two-piece set, exposed beams and large windows opening to a sunny landscape.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult Asian woman with a tanned glowing natural complexion, long dark wavy hair parted in the middle and realistic skin texture. She wears a white textured bandeau-style top with a central knot, detached off-shoulder ruffled sleeves and matching white side-tie bottoms, plus gold hoops, a delicate pendant chain, thin bangle and ring with white manicure. Preserve a natural feminine silhouette without explicit measurements.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium shot from thighs upward at eye level. The adult subject sits upright but relaxed on a white sofa, torso slightly angled left, left hand supporting on the cushion and right hand resting on the upper thigh, with one leg bent and the other extending along the sofa. Show white cushions, exposed white beams, large glass doors, a black lantern and lush trees with blue sky outside.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright high-key daylight from the right and front with soft diffused shadows and warm sunny tone. Keep the atmosphere clean, airy, luxurious and candid.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 4:5 or 2:3 frame, 50–85mm portrait lens, subject sharp with a softly distinct background, realistic skin, fabric, jewelry and architecture detail, natural color grading.
